theplopper.configuration.bypassOutputSid: If set to true, the plopper will output items to e.g. pipes at all sides instead of just the bottom.
theplopper.configuration.displayParticle: Whether particles should show up every time the plopper picks up an item.
theplopper.configuration.playSound.toolt: Whether a sound should be played when an item gets picked up by the plopper.
theplopper:plopper.tooltip: Picks up any items lying on the ground that are about to despawn in its general vicinity.
